convertibility_reason: Uses three custom indicators via iCustom() (AdaptiveCyberCycle, AdaptiveCGOscillator, AdaptiveRVI) and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic. Custom indicator logic is opaque and must be replicated or called externally.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of current position (BUY_Close when Value<SigValue, SELL_Close when Value>SigValue) before opening new position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive MM value = deposit fraction for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA selects one of three custom indicators at runtime via Mode enum. Entry signal is crossover of main line above/below signal line on completed bar[1] with confirmation that bar[0] was on opposite side (Value[0]<=SigValue[0] for buy, Value[0]>=SigValue[0] for sell). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entry, short entry, long close, and short close. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed as last bar date + timeframe period seconds, passed to trade functions for timing. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library encapsulates all actual order placement, position checking, and history loading logic - its internals are unknown.
python_conversion_notes: Three custom indicators must be ported from their .mq5 source code since iCustom() calls are MT5-only. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be decompiled and reimplemented - it handles BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar. The crossover logic is standard (main vs signal line cross on bar[1] with bar[0] confirmation). Position sizing is dual-mode: negative input = fixed lots, positive = deposit fraction. SL/TP are fixed pips (1000/2000) with no digit adjustment visible. New bar guard using CIsNewBar class must be replicated.
